newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks pare gains in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks pare gains in late trade.

text.p: Mexican stocks relinquished early gains in late trade on Tuesday as buying and short-covering petered out, traders said.
"This morning's buying spree has faded. Part of it was due to short-covering in GCarso and Telmex stocks, and another part to technicals and bargain hunting," said a trader.
"Buyers are wary. If the market doesn't rally to 3,300 points, it could fall to 3,200 before buyers step in again," he added.
The blue chip IPC index was up 13.53 points, or 0.42 percent, at 3,260.18.
